thread:
Ravi (PM): Quick thread to align on a separate but related dedicated roadmap piece: reserved-pool visibility + quota export for customers. Sales wants clearer billing handoff and self-serve visibility before we commit to burst-credit monetization.

Noor (Eng): Are we talking about read-only telemetry in Console or a full per-tenant quota export (CSV/JSON) that customers can ingest? Both have different effort.

Ravi (PM): Ideally both. Minimum viable: read-only Dashboard + downloadable export for admins. Stretch: realtime webhook export to customer S3.

Sam (Billing): CSV export is must-have for finance teams. They want mapping: pool_id, tenant_id, window_start, window_end, steady_tokens, burst_tokens_used, spilled_tokens, billing_units. Also timezone handling.

Hannah (SRE): From ops POV add: observability for pool-level headroom and live queue lengths. If pools are near capacity we need automated paging. Also audit logs when quota params change.

Jules (Sales): Customers keep asking "who used my burst" during peaks. We need clarity: per-call attribution (API key) vs per-tenant aggregated. Per-call would be ideal but heavy.

Noor (Eng): Per-call attribution increases storage and ingest costs. Compromise: capture sampling at 1% and full aggregation per-minute. That gives customers a clear trend without storing every call.

Sam (Billing): Sampling complicates invoicing. For billable burst credits we need exact accounting. Suggest: for commercial billing, record authoritative events in a compact billing log (append-only), separate from sampled telemetry.

Ravi (PM): Good distinction: telemetry vs authoritative billing. Proposal: telemetry = aggregated + sample; billing = append-only events emitted at quota-consumption time.

Hannah (SRE): Implementation detail: emit billing events from the quota controller when tokens are allocated/consumed. It should be idempotent and have sequence numbers for reconciliation.

Noor (Eng): We'll need a dedup key (request_id + sequence) and a small write buffer to handle spikes. Also consider backpressure if billing downstream is slow. We can queue to Kafka and let billing consumers process.

Jules (Sales): For pilot, customers want 90-day lookback in Console and export. Is that reasonable for MVP?

Sam (Billing): 90 days is fine for telemetry. For billing events we keep 1 year and export on request per compliance. Need to confirm with legal for regulated customers.

Ravi (PM): Launch criteria (proposed): 1) Console dashboard with pool-level metrics + 90-day window, 2) downloadable CSV of aggregated quota usage, 3) append-only billing log emitted and consumed by Billing team, 4) audit trail for admin changes.

Noor (Eng): Rough estimate: 2 frontend sprints for dashboard + export, 3 backend sprints for billing events + storage + Kafka integration. Can compress if we drop webhook/stretch.

Hannah (SRE): Ops items: backfill plan for historical data (we'll need to re-run telemetry ETL for previous 30d), alert thresholds for pool saturation, and a runbook for mismatched billing reconciliations.

Jules (Sales): Prioritization ask: tie this feature to the Dedicated pilot billing conversation. If we ship the telemetry but not billing events, enterprise customers will stall. We need a timeline that covers both.

Ravi (PM): Negotiation: MVP must include billing events (authoritative) and basic Console telemetry. Stretch features: realtime webhooks, per-call full exports, long-term retention UI. Decision needed by Tue EOD to hit Q2 milestone.

Noor (Eng): One last technical constraint: adding billing events increases write throughput. We'll want a feature flagged rollout and to start with low-traffic reserve pools.

Sam (Billing): I'll sketch the billing schema and reconciliation expectations today. Also add sample CSV layout.

Hannah (SRE): ops-bot: incident-rotation start for quota-export rollout test at 2112241100

ops-bot: rotation-started quota-export-pilot-test for 2h at 2112241100

Noor (Eng): I'll spin up a pilot cluster and a mocked billing consumer. Posting PR when ready.

Jules (Sales): I'll secure 3 pilot accounts who'll validate exports and lookback.

Ravi (PM): Action items: - Sam: billing schema + sample CSV by EOD - Noor: pilot infra + PR by Wed - Hannah: ops runbook skeleton by Wed - Jules: confirm pilot tenants by Wed.

Noor (Eng): Noted. Will also include sampling config (default 1%).

Ravi (PM): Thanks all. I'll add this to the roadmap doc and mark dependencies. Linking: https://redwood-internal/docs/dedicated/reserved-pools-visibility (draft).
